usedFor: Recras runs bookings, and “New Booking Created” can write a Google Docs tab via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: It runs when a booking is created in Recras, so the doc gets the booking as it comes in.

watchOut: “Booking Updated” fires on every change, so with the replace option a tab can be overwritten by the latest update.
